# Amedisys Home Health Care Services

Home Health Care

Skilled nursing and therapy to help you recover from illness, injury or surgery, or to manage
long-term conditions.

[Start Support ][107]

Hospice Care

Physical, emotional and spiritual care at the end of life, along with help for loved ones.

[Find Comfort ][108]

Palliative Care

Relief from pain and symptoms to help improve quality of life at any stage of a serious illness.

[Find Relief ][109]

Hospital-Level and Skilled Nursing Care at Home

Contessa, an Amedisys company, enables a new standard of care with provider partners and payors.

[Find Expertise ][110]

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.

  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]

  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.

  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

clinicians and caregivers offer individualized care, including physical, emotional and spiritual
support, so that
you and your loved ones can enjoy the best possible quality of life.

## Why choose us?

We’re committed to working with you and your family members to provide the best care possible.

[Our care adapts to your needs]

### Our care adapts to your needs

Different people have different needs, and those needs can change, sometimes quickly. Our caregivers
have the resources, skills, and training to respond rapidly and adapt their care as circumstances
evolve.

[We will guide you with grace]

### We will guide you with grace

When someone you love needs help, it can be hard to know what to do or even where to start. This is
where our care begins. We’re here to offer you the care and clarity you need with dignity and
respect.

[We deliver with heart]

### We deliver with heart

A warm smile. A kind word. A friend’s hand to hold your own. These seem like small things, but they
can make the difference between someone who is merely receiving care and someone who feels truly
cared for.

[National reach. Neighborly spirit]

### National reach. Neighborly spirit

Our national reach makes it possible for us to offer greater access to those in need. Our clinicians
often live in the same communities as our patients, giving us the opportunity to provide unique
resources wherever they’re needed.

[Read about our approach to care][53]

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

    cancer and specialty care.

    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## OUR MOTTO: COMPROMISE NOTHING

At Affirmed Home Care, we believe our clients deserve to live life on their terms—gracefully,
comfortably, and without limitation. Beyond providing exceptional nursing and personal care, we
offer a variety of support services to help them maintain the routines and experiences that bring
joy and a sense of well-being.

## Taking care to another level

Whether it’s accompanying a client to an important medical appointment, arranging a lunch date with
friends, ensuring they never miss a favorite salon visit, or coordinating travel for weddings,
vacations, and milestone celebrations, our team is there every step of the way. We provide not just
care but the freedom to continue enjoying life’s most meaningful moments.

## Our Services

Explore based on your needs
[ Skilled Nursing ][23] [ Part-time Care ][24] [ Pediatric Care ][25] [ Long-term Care ][26] [
Private Live-in Care ][27] [ Home Health Aides ][28]

today to see if we accept your plan. Please note that we do not accept Medicare & Medicaid.

## Across The Tristate Area
## & Right Near You

With over 2,500 nurses, caregivers, and medical support staff, we serve patients and families in New
York, New Jersey and Connecticut.
[ about us ][29]

## Quality In-Home Care, Designed Around You

From daily or part-time skilled nursing to pediatric and live-in care, our team of RNs, LPNs, home
care and live-in aides, and other support professionals brings personalized one-on-one care to
you—customized to your needs.
[ Why affirmed ][30]
In-Home Care is All About Peace of Mind

## Our Patients

service, I can say with certainty that everyone at Affirmed Home Care has been amazing…helpful,
professional, and kind.

impressed by the company’s commitment to excellence and innovation.

Our family is incredibly grateful to have found Affirmed Home Care, including Erin, our mother’s
caregiver, and her amazing team. They went a long way to helping to ease my mother’s transition to
home from rehab.

## OUR MOTTO: COMPROMISE NOTHING

At Affirmed Home Care, we believe our clients deserve to live life on their terms—gracefully,
comfortably, and without limitation. Beyond providing exceptional nursing and personal care, we
offer a variety of support services to help them maintain the routines and experiences that bring
joy and a sense of well-being.

## Taking care to another level

Whether it’s accompanying a client to an important medical appointment, arranging a lunch date with
friends, ensuring they never miss a favorite salon visit, or coordinating travel for weddings,
vacations, and milestone celebrations, our team is there every step of the way. We provide not just
care but the freedom to continue enjoying life’s most meaningful moments.

you—customized to your needs.

## Care that makes you feel truly cared for.

Top-quality healthcare is only where we get started. At Americare, we believe that how it’s
delivered is just as crucial. That’s why we offer care that:

### Focuses on you

We are deeply committed to providing personalized care to each patient. Our team takes the time to
understand your unique needs so that you receive the individualized attention and customized care
you deserve.

### Speaks your language

Speaking over 15 languages, our culturally diverse team allows us to serve a broad range of
communities. We speak your preferred language and offer personalized care in a culturally sensitive
manner.

### Doesn’t leave you waiting

Many of our services have round-the-clock availability, so that you always get the help you need
right when you need it.

## Why our patients love Americare

As my mother's primary caregiver, I struggled to juggle her needs after her debilitating stroke with
my full-time job and young kids at home. Having Americare's compassionate nurses provide skilled
care allowed mom to regain her strength and start caring for herself again. I'm so grateful for
their expertise and warmth.

S. Thompson

My father cherished his independence, so when he needed more assistance in his 90s, he was reluctant
to accept help. But Americare's home health aides quickly put him at ease with their friendly manner
and patience. They not only kept him safe, but also brought joy to his days with art projects and
puzzles. Dad looked forward to their visits.

James W.

Recovering from major surgery as a single woman with no family nearby was daunting. But Americare's
skilled nurses helped with my medications, changed bandages, and assisted me with getting to the
bathroom. Their thoughtful care gave me the support I required to get back on my feet again. I'll
never forget their kindness.

Jessica

My wife's early onset dementia turned our golden years upside down. As her memory rapidly declined,
she became frightened and agitated. Americare's specially trained staff took the time to get to know
her likes and dislikes. Their gentle approach kept her calm and comforted during a difficult time.
I'm forever grateful for their compassion.

M. Davis

Losing my young brother to cancer was devastating. When hospice care was recommended, Americare's
nurses and aides became part of our family. They kept him comfortable and let him pass peacefully at
home, surrounded by loved ones and his belongings. I can't imagine going through it without their
empathetic support.

Stephanie L.

As my wife's primary caregiver, I was burning out between medical appointments and household duties.
Having an Americare aide stop by regularly gave me a necessary break so I could recharge. She kept
my wife entertained while I ran errands or took a nap. Their service was a life-saver for both of
us.

M. Chen

At 90 years old, I cherished my independence but needed some help at home after being hospitalized.
My children had busy families and I didn't want to burden them. Americare's kind nurses helped me
with my medications, meal prep and light housework allowing me to recover while giving my family
peace of mind. I'm so thankful for their assistance.

Dorothy

Keeping up with the daily care needs of my wheelchair bound father at home became exhausting for our
family. Americare's home health aides gave him the expert care he required while giving us an
opportunity to recharge. We're so appreciative that we could keep Dad comfortable at home thanks to
their amazing support.

N. Rodrigez

As a busy single mom, I had no way to care for my elderly mother after her bad fall. With
Americare's skilled nurses stopping by, I knew mom would get the attentive care she deserved in
spite of my hectic schedule. I'm extremely grateful they were there for her when I couldn't be.

Lisa Brown

After major surgery, my social butterfly wife felt isolated and alone at home. But Americare's
thoughtful home health aides kept her company playing cards, doing crafts and enjoying friendly
conversation. They helped her feel safe and secure during recovery. My wife looked forward to their
uplifting visits.

D. Lee

The 2 nurses (James and Louise) and therapists (Carl and Jason) that Americare are sending for my
parents - I simply have no words. Their skill, attention, patience, dedication are making such an
incredible difference in the healing process. They treat my parents with unsurpassed dignity and are
truly vested in getting them better. Besides clearly being experts in their prospective fields they
show such compassion. Because of Americare, I know that I’m doing all that I can to help my parents
and entire family navigate this difficult, challenging, frightening time.

Penina Mezei

  Our services are designed to provide peace of mind, offering reliable, around-the-clock care in

  We are dedicated to ensuring complete satisfaction by delivering compassionate, consistent care

Answered Prayer Home Care Services helps individuals and families achieve a healthier, happier
quality of life by restoring independence and providing lasting peace of mind. Through
compassionate, personalized in-home care, clients are supported in maintaining safety, dignity, and

  discuss a care plan tailored to your situation.

# When Should You Consider Caregiving Assistance?

Answered Prayer Home Care Services helps individuals and families achieve a healthier, happier
quality of life by restoring independence and providing lasting peace of mind. Through
compassionate, personalized in-home care, clients are supported in maintaining safety, dignity, and
comfort in their own homes. Too often, the early signs that pediatric, special needs, or senior
in-home care is needed are overlooked. This can lead to caregiver burnout, increased stress, and
even personal injury—ultimately making it difficult for families to care for themselves and those
they love. Timely professional support ensures both clients and caregivers receive the care,
balance, and relief they deserve.

## Why Philadelphia Families Choose A-Team Home Care

ACHC-accredited, Medicare-certified, and accepted by Community HealthChoices, VetAssist, and the
OPTIONS Program — A-Team is Philadelphia’s most credentialed in-home care agency.

#### ACHC Accredited — Above State Standards

Accreditation Commission for Health Care certification goes beyond Pennsylvania Department of Health
licensing — it’s the gold standard families use to verify quality before placement.

#### Medicare, Medicaid & Community HealthChoices

Accepted by Medicare, Medicaid, Keystone First CHC, UPMC Community HealthChoices, and PA Health &
Wellness — care is covered for most Philadelphia-area families at little or no out-of-pocket cost.

#### Family Caregivers Get Paid

Through Pennsylvania’s Family Caregiver Program, family members caring for a loved one can be hired
and compensated as official caregivers. A-Team handles all enrollment, training, and paperwork.

#### Medicare-Certified Skilled Nursing

RN and LPN skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy — delivered
at home through a Medicare-certified home health agency.

#### Authorized VetAssist Provider

Eligible wartime veterans and surviving spouses receive VA-funded home care through the VetAssist
Program and the VA Aid & Attendance pension benefit. A-Team handles the full enrollment process — no
VA experience needed by the family.

#### Local Philadelphia Senior Care — Aging in Place

A-Team Home Care helps Greater Philadelphia families support aging in place — keeping a loved one
safe, independent, and at home. Two offices: 2751 N. 5th Street, Philadelphia and 2 Park Lane,
Feasterville-Trevose.

Our Services

## Home Care Services in Philadelphia & the Surrounding Counties

From personal care and companion care to specialized Alzheimer’s memory care, pediatric, autism, and
VetAssist programs — A-Team serves seniors, elderly adults, and families across Philadelphia, Bucks,
Montgomery, Delaware, and Chester counties.

[Signs an aging parent needs in-home care — personal care services Philadelphia, caregiver grooming
senior client at home][Signs an aging parent needs in-home care — personal care services
Philadelphia, caregiver grooming senior client at home]

### Personal Care

Comprehensive support with all activities of daily living — bathing, grooming, dressing, toileting,
and safe mobility — delivered with dignity by licensed personal care aides.
* → Difficulty bathing or dressing safely
* → Fall risk due to limited mobility
* → Family caregiver burnout
* → Gaps after hospital discharge

[Learn more →][138]

[Get paid to care for a family member in Pennsylvania — companion care services Philadelphia,
caregiver and senior woman doing puzzle together at home][Get paid to care for a family member in
Pennsylvania — companion care services Philadelphia, caregiver and senior woman doing puzzle
together at home]

### Companion Care

Meaningful engagement, light housekeeping, meal prep, transportation, and errands for homebound
seniors and elderly adults. Companion care also provides in-home respite care for family caregivers
— scheduled relief so primary caregivers can rest, recover, and return.
* → Social isolation and loneliness
* → Missed medical appointments
* → Unsafe meal preparation
* → Family unable to check in daily

[Learn more →][139]

[24-hour and live-in home care Philadelphia — caregiver with senior client at home][24-hour and
live-in home care Philadelphia — caregiver with senior client at home]

### 24-Hour & Live-In Care

Around-the-clock caregiver coverage for clients who require continuous supervision and support.
* → Safety risks for those who cannot be left alone
* → Nighttime wandering in dementia patients
* → Transitions home from nursing facilities
* → Refused facility placement

[Learn more →][140]

[Alzheimer's, dementia and memory care Philadelphia — caregiver with senior
patient][Alzheimer's, dementia and memory care Philadelphia — caregiver with senior patient]

### Alzheimer's, Dementia & Memory Care

Structured routines, redirection, and patient communication for Alzheimer’s disease, vascular
dementia, Lewy body dementia, and related conditions. A-Team’s memory care program supports clients
at every stage — from early cognitive changes to advanced dementia requiring 24-hour supervision.
* → Wandering and elopement risk
* → Agitation and sundowning

## Why Philadelphia Families Choose A-Team Home Care

ACHC-accredited, Medicare-certified, and accepted by Community HealthChoices, VetAssist, and the
OPTIONS Program — A-Team is Philadelphia’s most credentialed in-home care agency.

#### ACHC Accredited — Above State Standards

Accreditation Commission for Health Care certification goes beyond Pennsylvania Department of Health
licensing — it’s the gold standard families use to verify quality before placement.

#### Medicare, Medicaid & Community HealthChoices

Accepted by Medicare, Medicaid, Keystone First CHC, UPMC Community HealthChoices, and PA Health &
Wellness — care is covered for most Philadelphia-area families at little or no out-of-pocket cost.

#### Family Caregivers Get Paid

Through Pennsylvania’s Family Caregiver Program, family members caring for a loved one can be hired
and compensated as official caregivers. A-Team handles all enrollment, training, and paperwork.

#### Medicare-Certified Skilled Nursing

RN and LPN skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy — delivered
at home through a Medicare-certified home health agency.

#### Authorized VetAssist Provider

Eligible wartime veterans and surviving spouses receive VA-funded home care through the VetAssist
Program and the VA Aid & Attendance pension benefit. A-Team handles the full enrollment process — no
VA experience needed by the family.

#### Local Philadelphia Senior Care — Aging in Place

A-Team Home Care helps Greater Philadelphia families support aging in place — keeping a loved one
safe, independent, and at home. Two offices: 2751 N. 5th Street, Philadelphia and 2 Park Lane,
Feasterville-Trevose.

#### We are serving Indiana, Kentucky and Pennsylvania.

#### About Benchmark

## Who We Are

Benchmark Family Services is a network of professional, therapeutic foster homes and committed staff
across two states with the goal of providing stable out-of-home placements for children in need. We
work alongside child welfare agencies to provide stable care to youth in the least restrictive
setting possible as they work toward their goals. The results we see in the youth that pass through
our care encourage us to carry on in our mission to give even the most traumatized and troubled
children a safe and stable home.

[ Read More ][38]

#### What We Do

## What Is Therapeutic Foster Care?

How is therapeutic foster care different than regular foster care? Therapeutic foster homes care for
youth who have been severely neglected or abused. These therapeutic foster children can have a
number of presenting issues that are a direct result from their past. We also serve a number of
children with emotional, mental and physical disabilities. Most of the youth we serve are
adolescents who require more intensive care and support.

[ Read More ][39]

#### What People Say About Us

## Testimonials

I would just like to say how proud I am to be a member of the Benchmark family. They have excellent,
professional, and compassionate staff. They always meet the needs of our children, and are great at
supporting foster parents. As a 41 year veteran of being a foster parent, I’ve worked with many
agencies – and Benchmark is superb!
Terri PottsBFS Foster Parent
Words to describe Benchmark: supportive, honest, caring and passionate about helping children &
foster families! We are so blessed to have such an amazing agency!
Grant & Kimbra LoughBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark has been amazing to us! We could not have asked for a better organization for us & our
foster kids. Anytime we need help with anything from daycare vouchers to questions about services to
working with IEP’s, they are quick to respond. Our TSS has been there to answer our silly questions,
helped us navigate emotional & behavioral issues & anything else that pops up. We could not have
done this without them!
Mike and Donna BuckBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark staff have been very easy to work with. They have been very caring, supportive and helpful
with anything we need, even at odd hours of the day. The staff goes above and beyond to help make
things flow and make life less stressful. They have definitely been a big support to my husband and
I as new foster parents and have the kids’ best interest in mind.
Mechelle and Herman GarciaBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark is an awesome foster care agency! The staff is great to work with and they are always
there to support the kids and foster families! Working with Benchmark has been a great experience.
Jen SheltonBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark Family Services has been wonderful to us over the past two years. They are there to help
you and support you through everything going on. They have great training options, and are willing
to accommodate your specific training schedule and needs. When you come to Benchmark, it’s like
“welcome to the family”, and not just welcome to another agency.
Jorden & Lacey BaldridgeBFS Foster Parents
I thank God for Benchmark, they are always there. With any doubts, fears, or concerns, they are
always there to help and to listen. It’s been a wonderful experience!
Shane & Sabrina BackBFS Foster Parents

##  Care for Every Stage of Life at Home

Whether your loved one needs daily assistance, companionship, memory care, or short-term support
after a hospital stay, we provide dependable in-home care tailored to your situation. We support:


* Seniors who want to remain at home
* Individuals recovering from illness or surgery
* Families caring for loved ones with memory loss
* Children with medical or developmental needs
* Family caregivers who need reliable help



Better Hands Home Care Solutions serves families throughout Sebring, Winter Haven, Lake Placid, Avon
Park, Lakeland, and surrounding communities across Highlands County and Polk County. We accept
Medicaid and most major insurance providers. Whether you need a few hours of support each week or
consistent daily care, we build a plan around your situation. If you are not sure what type of care
is needed, call us, and we will help you figure that out.

## Why Families in Sebring and Winter Haven Choose Better Hands Home Care Solutions

When you are looking for home care in Sebring, Winter Haven, or the surrounding communities of
Highlands County and Polk County, you are not just comparing a list of services. You are trying to
figure out who you can actually trust and who will show up consistently when your family needs them
most. Here is what families across Central Florida rely on when they choose Better Hands Home Care
Solutions:

* Easy to reach when you have questions or need help
* Clear answers without pressure or confusion
* Caregivers matched based on fit, not just availability
* Consistent support without a constant rotation of new faces
* Help understand care options, including Medicaid when applicable
* Bilingual support available in English and Spanish



We focus on keeping things simple, dependable, and easy to work with — because that is what families
dealing with difficult situations actually need.

## Our Home Care Services

### **Personal Care**

Hands-on support with daily routines, including bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility assistance,
and hygiene. We help your loved one maintain dignity, safety, and independence at home

[ Learn More ][71]

### **Companion Care**

Reliable companionship, light housekeeping, meal preparation, transportation to appointments, and
consistent social engagement to keep your loved one connected and safe.

[ Learn More ][72]

### **Alzheimer’s and Dementia Care**

Structured, patient-centered care focused on safety, routine, wandering prevention, and reducing
confusion and agitation for individuals living with memory loss.

[ Learn More ][73]

### **Post-Hospital Care**

Short-term in-home support after discharge to help your loved one follow recovery instructions,
manage medications, prevent falls, and avoid unnecessary return trips to the hospital.

[ Learn More ][74]

### **Hospice Support**

Compassionate, non-medical care focused on comfort, dignity, and family relief. We support both your
loved one and your family during this difficult time.

[ Learn More ][75]

### **Pediatric Home Care**

Dependable in-home support for children with medical or developmental needs, including personal
care, mobility assistance, medication reminders, and respite care for parents.

[ Learn More ][76]

## Care You Can Feel Confident About

Choosing in-home care is a big decision. You need to know your loved one is safe, supported, and in
the right hands. We do not assign caregivers based on availability alone. We take time to understand
your needs, match the right caregiver, and provide consistent, reliable support you can depend on.


* Carefully selected caregivers
* Consistent, familiar faces
* Clear communication with families
* Focus on safety, dignity, and respect



Every caregiver serving families in Sebring, Winter Haven, and across Central Florida goes through a
thorough background screening process and is selected for their reliability, patience, and ability
to provide respectful, consistent care in a home setting. You are not left guessing. You know who is
coming into your home, what kind of care your loved one is receiving, and that someone dependable is
there. And if something changes, you will hear from us directly.

## Serving Families Across Central Florida

Better Hands Home Care Solutions operates from two locations — Sebring, serving Highlands County and
surrounding communities, and Winter Haven, serving Polk County and surrounding communities. Our
caregivers travel directly to clients' homes so your loved one receives support in the comfort and
familiarity of their own environment.

﻿

* Sebring
* Lake Placid
* Avon Park
* Winter Haven
* Lakeland
* Polk County
* Highlands County



If you are unsure whether we serve your area, call us and we will let you know right away.

## Getting Started Is Simple

Most families are not sure where to begin when they first start looking into home care in Sebring,
Winter Haven, or the surrounding area. That is completely normal. Our process is designed to take
the pressure off you from the very first call.



**Step 1 —** Call us or request a free consultation. You will speak directly with someone who can
help. No call center and no automated system.



**Step 2 —** We listen to your situation. We ask a few simple questions to understand your needs,
your loved one's daily routine, and the level of care required.



**Step 3 —** We build a care plan around your family. We outline the right type of care, a suggested
schedule, and clear information about cost and payment options, including Medicaid.



**Step 4 —** We match you with the right caregiver. We focus on fit, consistency, and making sure
your loved one feels comfortable from day one.



No pressure. No complicated process. Just clear answers and dependable support from a team that
serves Sebring, Winter Haven, and the surrounding Central Florida communities.

## Let’s Talk About What You Need

If something has changed and you are starting to look into home care for a loved one in Sebring,
Winter Haven, or the surrounding Central Florida area, now is the time to get answers. You do not
need to have everything figured out before you call. You do not need to know exactly what type of
care is needed or how much it will cost. That is what we are here to help you determine. Call us
today and speak directly with someone who understands your situation. No call center. No pressure.
Just a real conversation about what your family needs and how we can help.

# What to Expect

From your first conversation to the day of your appointment, every session is approached with
communication, professionalism, and thoughtful care. 

After you contact Blue Ember Massage, we'll discuss your needs, location, and scheduling preferences
to determine the best approch for your session.

You will be sent required paperwork via email to complete before your first session. You'll receive
confirmation prior to your appointment. 

A quiet, comfortable space large enough for a massage table is ideal whenever possible in the agreed
upon location.  

Massage therapy is provided using therapeutic techniques and supportive tools when appropriate for
your care.

Payment is collected at time of booking or within a set timeframe after booking is confirmed. See
[FAQ][16] for additional information. 

### Frequently Asked Questions

### Booking & Scheduling

How do I book a session?


Appointments may be requested by phone, text message, email, or contact form. After reaching out,
we'll discuss your therapeutic needs, preferred location, scheduling availability, and the best
approach for your session before confirming your appointment.

Do you require a deposit?


Deposits may be required for appointments involving extended travel distances or specialty
scheduling needs. Any required deposit will be discussed during booking and applied toward the total
cost of your session.

Do you offer recurring appointments?


Yes. Recurring appointments may be scheduled weekly, biweekly, monthly, or as needed. Sessions may
be tailored to support ongoing pain management, recovery, maintenance care, and overall wellness.

When is payment collected?


Payment is collected at the time of booking or within a designated timeframe following booking
confirmation. Additional payment details will be provided during scheduling.

How far in advance should I schedule?


Scheduling in advance is encouraged whenever possible, especially for preferred appointment times or
extended travel locations. Same-week or last-minute availability may occasionally be available
depending on scheduling.

What is your cancellation policy?


Appointments canceled with at least 48 hrs' notice may be rescheduled without charge. Cancellations
with less than 24 hrs' notice may be subject to a fee, and same day cancellations or missed
appointments may be charged the full session fee. Exceptions may be considered for emergencies or
unforeseen circumstances.

### Preparing for Your Appointment

How does mobile massage work?


Your therapist travels to you with a portable massage table and necessary supplies, allowing
sessions to take place in a familiar and comfortable setting without the need to travel.

How much space is needed?


A quiet, space large enough to safely accommodate a massage table and allow room to move around is
ideal whenever possible. Space needs may vary slightly depending on the type of treatment being
provided.

Can I request specific preferences or accommodations?


Yes. Communication is encouraged before and during your session regarding comfort, pressure
preferences, positioning needs, sensory sensitivities, or other concerns to help support a positive
therapeutic experience.

What should I expect during my first session?


Your first session begins with a brief intake regarding your health history, areas of concern, and
comfort level. Treatment approaches may be adjusted during the session based on communication,
comfort, and your needs.

Do I need to complete paperwork?


Yes. Required intake and consent paperwork must be completed prior to your first session whenever
possible. Forms are typically sent electronically, though paper copies may be available if needed.

Do I need to provide anything?


A quiet, comfortable space large enough for a massage table is ideal whenever possible. Requests for
the use of an electrical outlet may be needed. Please note access to properties and homes with
minimal stairs is preferred.

Will I need to provide identification?


A valid government-issued photo ID may be requested prior to your first appointment and visually
confirmed at the time of service. This helps support required recordkeeping, client verification and
a safe mobile massage experience.

What should I wear?


Comfortable clothing is recommended before and after your session. Depending on the type of care
being provided, some sessions may remain fully clothed. Whenever clothing is removed for treatment,
professional draping is always used.

### Services & Therapeutic Care

What services do you offer?


Blue Ember Massage offers Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy, Deep Tissue Massage, Neuromuscular
Therapy, Trigger Point Therapy, Reflexology, Scar Release Therapy, Trauma-Informed & PTSD Support,
and Hot Stone Therapy, including Himalayan Salt Stones.

What does trauma-informed care mean during a session?


Trauma-informed care is approached with clear communication, professional boundaries,
predictability, and sensitivity to comfort throughout the session. Clients are encouraged to
communicate preferences, in decisions regarding their care at any time.

Do all sessions include the same techniques?


No. Each session is guided by your health history, areas of concern, comfort level, and response to
treatment. Care may be adjusted from session to session based on your progress and needs at the
time.

Are hot stones included?


Yes. Hot stones, including Himalayan salt stones, may be incorporated when appropriate as part of
your session to provide gentle warmth, relax tight muscles, and complement hands- on bodywork.

What is scar release therapy?


Scar release therapy may incorporate manual techniques and Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy to address
restrictions and adhesions associated with scar tissue following surgery, injury, or tissue trauma.
Both recent and longstanding scars may benefit from scar-focused care when appropriate.

What is Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy?


Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy is a gentle, non-invasive microcurrent therapy that may be
incorporated to support a variety of treatment goals. [Additional information, educational
resources, and brochures ][17]are available below for those interested in learning more.

### Medical Considerations

Are there times massage should be avoided?


Yes. Certain acute illnesses, infections, injuries, and skin conditions may require postponing or
modifying treatment. If you are unsure whether massage is appropriate, please contact Blue Ember
Massage prior to your appointment.

Can I receive massage with a sunburn?


Massage cannot be provided over an active sunburn, significant skin irritation, or certain acute
skin conditions, as treatment may increase discomfort or further irritate the tissue. If you are
unsure, please reach out before your appointment.

What medical conditions should I disclose?


Please disclose any medical conditions, injuries, surgeries, allergies, medications, implanted
medical devices, or other health concerns that may affect your care. Providing accurate health
information helps support a safe and appropriate treatment approach.

Massage. ]
[My Approach ][13]

## My Therapeutic Approach

###### 
###### Healing is not one-size-fits-all. Every person carries a unique story, level of comfort, and
###### therapeutic needs. My approach is centered on building trust through clear communication,
###### professionalism, and genuine connection. 
###### 
###### A strong therapeutic relationship creates the foundation for individualized care. Every
###### session is guided by mutual trust, respect, and collaboration while recognizing that no two
###### clients or paths to healing are exactly alike.
###### 
###### Whether assisting with pain relief, recovery, nervous system regulation, scar tissue care, or
###### trauma-informed support, sessions are approached with a variety of therapeutic techniques.
###### Supportive tools may be incorporated when appropriate to help with comfort, mobility,
###### healing, and overall well-being.
######  

## Therapeutic Services & Support

Explore the services available through Blue Ember Massage and the many ways care may be tailored to
your individual needs.

### [Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy][14]

Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy uses Microcurrent Point Stimulation (MPS) Therapy to support pain
management, scar release, vagus nerve support, nervous system regulation, sensory balancing, and the
body’s natural healing response as part of individualized therapeutic care.

### Pain Managment & Recovery

Persistent pain and muscular tension may continue affecting daily life long after injury, overuse,
or chronic stress. Treatment plans may incorporate Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy and hands-on
bodywork to address chronic pain, physical discomfort, and tension throughout the body. 

### Trauma-Informed & PTSD Support

Support for veterans, first responders, and individuals experiencing PTSD or trauma-related tension,
including survivors and those navigating the lasting effects of trauma. Care is approached with
communication, predictability, professional boundaries, and sensitivity to comfort throughout the
session.

### Therapeutic Bodywork & Specialized Techniques

Therapeutic bodywork may incorporate a variety of hands-on techniques, including Deep Tissue,
Swedish Massage, Neuromuscular Therapy, Trigger Point Therapy, Reflexology, and other modalities
based on your body's needs each session.

### [Scar Release Therapy][15]

Scar tissue-focused therapeutic care may incorporate manual cross fiber friction therapy and Dolphin
Neurostim™ MPS Therapy to support tissue mobility, comfort, healing, and recovery following injury,
surgery, or trauma to the tissue.

### Therapeutic Hot Stones

Heated Himalayan salt stones may be incorporated when appropriate to provide warmth, encourage
muscle relaxation, complement hands-on bodywork, and enhance comfort while supporting individualized
care. Himalayan salt stones have long been valued in holistic wellness practices.

# What to Expect

From your first conversation to the day of your appointment, every session is approached with
communication, professionalism, and thoughtful care. 

After you contact Blue Ember Massage, we'll discuss your needs, location, and scheduling preferences
to determine the best approch for your session.

You will be sent required paperwork via email to complete before your first session. You'll receive
confirmation prior to your appointment. 

A quiet, comfortable space large enough for a massage table is ideal whenever possible in the agreed
upon location.  

Massage therapy is provided using therapeutic techniques and supportive tools when appropriate for
your care.

Payment is collected at time of booking or within a set timeframe after booking is confirmed. See
[FAQ][16] for additional information. 

### Frequently Asked Questions

### Booking & Scheduling

How do I book a session?


Appointments may be requested by phone, text message, email, or contact form. After reaching out,
we'll discuss your therapeutic needs, preferred location, scheduling availability, and the best
approach for your session before confirming your appointment.

Do you require a deposit?


Deposits may be required for appointments involving extended travel distances or specialty
scheduling needs. Any required deposit will be discussed during booking and applied toward the total
cost of your session.

Do you offer recurring appointments?


Yes. Recurring appointments may be scheduled weekly, biweekly, monthly, or as needed. Sessions may
be tailored to support ongoing pain management, recovery, maintenance care, and overall wellness.

When is payment collected?


Payment is collected at the time of booking or within a designated timeframe following booking
confirmation. Additional payment details will be provided during scheduling.

How far in advance should I schedule?


Scheduling in advance is encouraged whenever possible, especially for preferred appointment times or
extended travel locations. Same-week or last-minute availability may occasionally be available
depending on scheduling.

What is your cancellation policy?


Appointments canceled with at least 48 hrs' notice may be rescheduled without charge. Cancellations
with less than 24 hrs' notice may be subject to a fee, and same day cancellations or missed
appointments may be charged the full session fee. Exceptions may be considered for emergencies or
unforeseen circumstances.

### Preparing for Your Appointment

How does mobile massage work?


Your therapist travels to you with a portable massage table and necessary supplies, allowing
sessions to take place in a familiar and comfortable setting without the need to travel.

How much space is needed?


A quiet, space large enough to safely accommodate a massage table and allow room to move around is
ideal whenever possible. Space needs may vary slightly depending on the type of treatment being
provided.

Can I request specific preferences or accommodations?


Yes. Communication is encouraged before and during your session regarding comfort, pressure
preferences, positioning needs, sensory sensitivities, or other concerns to help support a positive
therapeutic experience.

What should I expect during my first session?


Your first session begins with a brief intake regarding your health history, areas of concern, and
comfort level. Treatment approaches may be adjusted during the session based on communication,
comfort, and your needs.

Do I need to complete paperwork?


Yes. Required intake and consent paperwork must be completed prior to your first session whenever
possible. Forms are typically sent electronically, though paper copies may be available if needed.

Do I need to provide anything?


A quiet, comfortable space large enough for a massage table is ideal whenever possible. Requests for
the use of an electrical outlet may be needed. Please note access to properties and homes with
minimal stairs is preferred.

Will I need to provide identification?


A valid government-issued photo ID may be requested prior to your first appointment and visually
confirmed at the time of service. This helps support required recordkeeping, client verification and
a safe mobile massage experience.

What should I wear?


Comfortable clothing is recommended before and after your session. Depending on the type of care
being provided, some sessions may remain fully clothed. Whenever clothing is removed for treatment,
professional draping is always used.

### Services & Therapeutic Care

What services do you offer?


Blue Ember Massage offers Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy, Deep Tissue Massage, Neuromuscular
Therapy, Trigger Point Therapy, Reflexology, Scar Release Therapy, Trauma-Informed & PTSD Support,
and Hot Stone Therapy, including Himalayan Salt Stones.

What does trauma-informed care mean during a session?


Trauma-informed care is approached with clear communication, professional boundaries,
predictability, and sensitivity to comfort throughout the session. Clients are encouraged to
communicate preferences, in decisions regarding their care at any time.

Do all sessions include the same techniques?


No. Each session is guided by your health history, areas of concern, comfort level, and response to
treatment. Care may be adjusted from session to session based on your progress and needs at the
time.

Are hot stones included?


Yes. Hot stones, including Himalayan salt stones, may be incorporated when appropriate as part of
your session to provide gentle warmth, relax tight muscles, and complement hands- on bodywork.

What is scar release therapy?


Scar release therapy may incorporate manual techniques and Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy to address
restrictions and adhesions associated with scar tissue following surgery, injury, or tissue trauma.
Both recent and longstanding scars may benefit from scar-focused care when appropriate.

What is Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy?


Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy is a gentle, non-invasive microcurrent therapy that may be
incorporated to support a variety of treatment goals. [Additional information, educational
resources, and brochures ][17]are available below for those interested in learning more.

### Medical Considerations

Are there times massage should be avoided?


Yes. Certain acute illnesses, infections, injuries, and skin conditions may require postponing or
modifying treatment. If you are unsure whether massage is appropriate, please contact Blue Ember
Massage prior to your appointment.

Can I receive massage with a sunburn?


Massage cannot be provided over an active sunburn, significant skin irritation, or certain acute
skin conditions, as treatment may increase discomfort or further irritate the tissue. If you are
unsure, please reach out before your appointment.

What medical conditions should I disclose?


Please disclose any medical conditions, injuries, surgeries, allergies, medications, implanted

for speech therapy. With less paperwork, a more flexible schedule, and meaningful one-on-one time,
she helps kiddos like Chloe thrive using eye gaze technology — all in the comfort of her own home.

### LPN, Jacksonville, FL

Sasha joined Care Options for Kids looking for a more meaningful, less stressful nursing experience
— and found precisely that. She loves the one-on-one connection with patients, the supportive team,
and the flexibility to balance work and life. Moments like seeing Jesse’s heartfelt smile remind her
she’s exactly where she’s meant to be.

tailored to daily life. Laura enjoys helping kids thrive right where they’re most comfortable.

### Your Caring Support Team

They say it takes a village to raise a child. That’s never more true than when your child faces a
challenge — but you don’t have to face it alone. When you’ve got questions, we’ve got answers. We’ll
walk you through every step. With the support of a care community, your family will finally feel
relief.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

## In case you were wondering..

Here are some answers to the questions you may have.

What kind of company is Digital Samba?

We’re not big tech - far from it. We’re a small, dedicated team of video conferencing nerds, and
we’ve been around since 2003. We’ve focused exclusively on video conferencing since before Skype was
a thing. It’s what we do, and it’s all we do.

Why have I never heard of Digital Samba?

Fair question - and it has a few answers. First, we've been flying under the radar for years. Our
core product has always been fully white-label, meaning our tech powers other brands' video
platforms. Second, we’re engineers, not marketers. And third, we’re bootstrapped - no investors, no
flashy ad campaigns. We've grown slowly and sustainably, which comes with advantages... and, yeah, a
few visibility drawbacks.

Why are you offering this for free?

Because we’re frustrated too. Big tech keeps pushing the boundaries on surveillance and eroding user
privacy. We wanted to create something that respects people - and their data. So we built a free
version that’s actually private, actually useful, and actually free. It’s our way of pushing back
and giving people an alternative.

Is this really free, or is there a catch?

Yes, it’s really free - and no, there’s no catch. We’re not selling your data, injecting ads, or
doing anything shady behind the scenes. The goal is simple: raise awareness of Digital Samba by
offering something genuinely valuable for free. Our business model is B2B - we make money from
companies who need our paid product (Digital Samba Embedded). The free version is here to stay, for
people like you.

What features are included?

A crazy amount - seriously. Take a look at the [full feature list][39], and if you need something
that is missing, let us know - we’re listening.

How do I create an account?
We’ve heard your requests loud and clear, and we’ve launched accounts in beta. [Register for beta
access right now][40]!
Can I use this without signing up?

Absolutely. No sign-up, no email, no friction. Just head to the [top of this page][41] and launch a
call instantly. You can also generate meeting links that stay active for 30 days.

A little caveat.. if you need more advanced scheduling features, you'll need to create an account,
which you can do by [registering for beta access][42].

How secure is Digital Samba?
Security is built into everything we do. Your calls are encrypted in transit with SSL/TLS, and
end-to-end encryption (E2EE) is applied where it matters most. We run entirely on European
infrastructure and follow strict security practices to keep your data safe. We’re GDPR-compliant,
follow SOC 1-aligned processes, and are committed to doing things the right way.
Do you track or store my data?
We don’t track you - simple as that. We only store the data you choose to upload or share, like
presentation files. That data stays private and fully under your control. We don’t analyse it,
monetise it, or use it for anything beyond delivering your meeting.
Who are your sub-processors?

We keep the list short - and genuinely European. A lot of companies claim to use “European
infrastructure,” but many of those providers are actually owned by foreign tech giants. We’re picky
about who we work with, and we only use a small number of EU-owned sub-processors.

If you're curious, take a look at our [Data Processing Agreement][43] (DPA). Despite the name, it
covers both Digital Samba (our free offering) and Digital Samba Embedded.
Can I customise it with my own branding?
Not in the free version - we’re using that to build our own brand. But with [Digital Samba
Embedded][44], you get full white-label control. You can customise everything: domains, URLs, logos,
colours, fonts - whatever fits your brand.
Can I integrate Digital Samba into my own software or website?
Yes! That’s exactly what [Digital Samba Embedded][45] is for. It’s fully customisable and designed
to plug into your platform with ease.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

## **Overview**

INTEGRATED® is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) based in Houston, Texas USA. From it’s
beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and engineer
industry standard pressure and flow control equipment that is utilized in the drilling and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas industry worldwide.

INTEGRATED® “State of the Art” manufacturing plants (Capital Equipment and Elastomers) are fully API
licensed facilities that operate as per our certified API / DNV Quality Management Systems (QMS)
processes. These facilities manufacture our OEM and Aftermarket products.

INTEGRATED® products are utilized worldwide by Land &  Platform Drilling Contractors, Well Service
Companies (including Snubbing), Rental Tool Companies, Completion Companies, major and independent
Energy Companies and are distributed globally through either INTEGRATED facility, Authorized
Licensed Repair Facilities (ARLF) or territorial partnerships.

[Patient Schedule]

### Patient Schedule

Empower both new and established patients to self-schedule online through websites, social media,
and your webpage. Patients easily filter through services and schedule appropriate appointments via
customizable decision trees. Reduce inbound phone calls and stay on top of visits with real-time
schedule updates and waitlist options to keep your day moving.

[[Explore Patient Schedule]][55]
[Patient Notify]

### Patient Notify

Keep patient appointments top-of-mind with phone, text, or email reminders. Eliminate manual
processes by automating communications about upcoming visits, administrative communications,
organization announcements, and even payment reminders by provider, location, practice, or any
criteria you choose.

[[Explore Patient Notify]][56]
[Patient Intake]

### Patient Intake

Patients can check in and complete registration forms at home, in the car, or in the lobby.
Digitization and automation of patient documents reduces manual re-keying of information and helps
ensure data accuracy. All information fields are linked to the EHR or practice management system and
automatically populate the patient account.

[[Explore Patient Intake]][57]
[Patient Portal]

### Patient Portal

Provide all the information your patients need in a single, convenient location. Appointment
scheduling, provider messaging, lab results, care plans, and online forms are accessible from our
iOS/Android app or any web browser. Ensure a consistent experience across all patient touch points
by customizing the portal with your logo and brand colors.

[[Explore Patient Portal]][58]
[Patient Intake]

### Patient Intake

Patients can conveniently approve consents, confirm demographic information, or fill in outstanding
registration forms via a mobile phone or tablet. All data is reconciled back to their respective
fields in the EHR and practice management system.

[[Explore Patient Intake]][59]
[Patient eHealth]

### Patient eHealth

Provide an all-in-one telehealth platform that can hold multiple participants per session. The
waiting feature allows patient handoff as part of the visit, mimicking an in-person encounter. The
Healthy Outcomes platform provides access to patient intake forms, creating a seamless experience
for providers.

[[Explore Patient eHealth]][60]
[Patient Survey]

### Patient Survey

Gain valuable patient insights and reviews with automated surveys. Convenient email or text
messaging simplifies delivery and encourages participation. Send patient surveys based on any data
set, including clinical, demographic, payer type, or custom, to capture patient-reported outcomes
and vital patient satisfaction feedback.

[[Explore Patient Survey]][61]
[Patient Activate]

### Patient Activate

Encourage patients to take an active role in staying healthy. Easily create "set and forget"
campaigns for health plan adherence, education, and marketing based on diagnostic, financial, or
demographic criteria. This outreach engine is tailored to patient communication preferences,
including phone, text, or email. Same-day notifications can be dispatched in minutes to alert
patients to office closures or any last-minute announcements.

[[Explore Patient Activate]][62]
[Patient Portal]

### Patient Portal

Patients can conveniently view lab results, visit summaries, request medication refills, and manage
their health information. Secure messaging encourages communication with providers and streamlines
clinician responses to medical questions.

[[Explore Patient Portal]][63]

### Patient Schedule

Empower both new and established patients to self-schedule online through websites, social media,
and your webpage. Patients easily filter through services and schedule appropriate appointments via
customizable decision trees. Reduce inbound phone calls and stay on top of visits with real-time
schedule updates and waitlist options to keep your day moving.

[[Explore Patient Schedule]][55]
[Patient Notify]

### Patient Notify

Keep patient appointments top-of-mind with phone, text, or email reminders. Eliminate manual
processes by automating communications about upcoming visits, administrative communications,
organization announcements, and even payment reminders by provider, location, practice, or any
criteria you choose.

[[Explore Patient Notify]][56]
[Patient Intake]

### Patient Intake

Patients can check in and complete registration forms at home, in the car, or in the lobby.
Digitization and automation of patient documents reduces manual re-keying of information and helps
ensure data accuracy. All information fields are linked to the EHR or practice management system and
automatically populate the patient account.

[[Explore Patient Intake]][57]
[Patient Portal]

### Patient Portal

Provide all the information your patients need in a single, convenient location. Appointment
scheduling, provider messaging, lab results, care plans, and online forms are accessible from our
iOS/Android app or any web browser. Ensure a consistent experience across all patient touch points
by customizing the portal with your logo and brand colors.

[[Explore Patient Portal]][58]
[Patient Intake]

### Patient Intake

Patients can conveniently approve consents, confirm demographic information, or fill in outstanding
registration forms via a mobile phone or tablet. All data is reconciled back to their respective
fields in the EHR and practice management system.

[[Explore Patient Intake]][59]
[Patient eHealth]

### Patient eHealth

Provide an all-in-one telehealth platform that can hold multiple participants per session. The
waiting feature allows patient handoff as part of the visit, mimicking an in-person encounter. The
Healthy Outcomes platform provides access to patient intake forms, creating a seamless experience
for providers.

[[Explore Patient eHealth]][60]
[Patient Survey]

### Patient Survey

Gain valuable patient insights and reviews with automated surveys. Convenient email or text
messaging simplifies delivery and encourages participation. Send patient surveys based on any data
set, including clinical, demographic, payer type, or custom, to capture patient-reported outcomes
and vital patient satisfaction feedback.

[[Explore Patient Survey]][61]
[Patient Activate]

### Patient Activate

Encourage patients to take an active role in staying healthy. Easily create "set and forget"
campaigns for health plan adherence, education, and marketing based on diagnostic, financial, or
demographic criteria. This outreach engine is tailored to patient communication preferences,
including phone, text, or email. Same-day notifications can be dispatched in minutes to alert
patients to office closures or any last-minute announcements.

[[Explore Patient Activate]][62]
[Patient Portal]

### Patient Portal

Patients can conveniently view lab results, visit summaries, request medication refills, and manage
their health information. Secure messaging encourages communication with providers and streamlines
clinician responses to medical questions.

[[Explore Patient Portal]][63]

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

Kidscare Home Health currently offers home therapy and private duty nursing. We are committed to

Our highly qualified nurses work alongside our therapists, providing children the best possible care
specific to your child’s needs 7 days a week, 24 hours a day.

Our diverse team of specialists are experts and work with children in a variety of areas including:

KidsCare Home Health is committed to building on our foundation of changing lives through
**C.A.R.E.**

Deeply rooted in the philosophy that excellence is achieved through continuous improvement, KidsCare
Home Health is committed to offering our employees a stable, nurturing work environment, and to
growing within the pediatric communities in the areas we service and beyond.

Our commitment to excellence in service is surpassed only by our commitment to ethical
professionalism, personal integrity, and dedication to the children we serve and the lives we have
the privilege of touching.

KidsCare Home Health provides services nationwide and is continuing to expand to more states.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].
