# Compassionate, high-quality pediatric home health services that help children thrive in the
# comfort and security of their homes.

## M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC specialize in a range of home health services for
## children.

[A pediatric home health nurse sits a young child in the comfort of her own home, emphasizing the
importance of pediatric home health care.]

## What We Do

## [Licensed Nursing Care][22]

Our licensed nurses provide in-home medical care such as, but not limited to, medication
administration, wound care, respiratory care, tube feedings, and management of chronic conditions
like asthma and diabetes.

## [Certified Home Health Aides][23]

Our certified aides assist with activities of daily living (ADLs), providing support for families
with tasks such as, but not limited to, bathing, feeding, functional mobility, and hygiene. Our
aides are compassionate, reliable, and committed to building a bond with the children they care for.

## Why Choose Us?

Empathetic Leadership Family-Centered Care A Trusted Team Care Coordination Insurance & Billing
Assistance

Our CEO’s personal journey with pediatric home health care informs every decision we make. He is
deeply committed to ensuring that every child and family we work with receives the same level of
compassionate, high-quality care that supported his own family.

Understanding the physical, emotional, and logistical challenges that families face is at the core
of our service. We work closely with families to provide the support, education, and resources
needed to navigate the complexities of caring for a child with medical needs. We believe that family
is at the heart of pediatric care. We actively involve families in the care process, and empower
them in their child’s care.

Our licensed nurses, and aides are more than just healthcare providers. They are caregivers who
understand the unique needs of pediatric patients and their families. Many of our team members have
a personal experience with pediatric medical conditions and caregiving, making them not only
qualified but deeply empathetic.

Our multidisciplinary team works together to create a comprehensive care plan for each child. We
coordinate with pediatricians, specialists, and other medical providers to ensure seamless,
well-rounded care is provided.

Navigating insurance and billing can be overwhelming. Our team is here to help you understand your
options, ensure eligibility, and manage the financial aspects of care, making the process as easy as
possible.

## Our Values

### Compassion

We treat every child and family with the highest level of kindness, empathy, and respect.

### Integrity

We operate with honesty, transparency, and accountability in all aspects of our care.

### Excellence

Following evidence based practice and providing continued education ensures that we provide the
highest standard of care in all of our services.

### Collaboration

We work closely with families and their healthcare team to ensure comprehensive, coordinated care is
provided.

## Ensuring Quality Pediatric Home Health Services Through Licensing and Accreditation

M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC is actively completing the required state licensing
process through the California Department of Public Health. This approval allows us to officially
provide licensed pediatric nursing, home health aide services, and care coordination in the home.
Once this step is finalized, we will move into the accreditation phase through a nationally
recognized accrediting body. Accreditation includes a detailed review of our safety procedures,
clinical standards, staff training, and care quality to ensure that our services meet the highest
level of professional excellence.

While we complete these important requirements, our team is preparing all systems, care protocols,
and support resources so we can begin serving families as soon as licensure is granted. We will
announce our official start date for accepting new clients shortly, and we are excited to support
children and families across Northern California.

# comfort and security of their homes.

## M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC specialize in a range of home health services for
## children.

[A pediatric home health nurse sits a young child in the comfort of her own home, emphasizing the
importance of pediatric home health care.]

## What We Do

## [Licensed Nursing Care][22]

Our licensed nurses provide in-home medical care such as, but not limited to, medication
administration, wound care, respiratory care, tube feedings, and management of chronic conditions
like asthma and diabetes.

## [Certified Home Health Aides][23]

Our certified aides assist with activities of daily living (ADLs), providing support for families
with tasks such as, but not limited to, bathing, feeding, functional mobility, and hygiene. Our
aides are compassionate, reliable, and committed to building a bond with the children they care for.

## Why Choose Us?

Empathetic Leadership Family-Centered Care A Trusted Team Care Coordination Insurance & Billing
Assistance

Our CEO’s personal journey with pediatric home health care informs every decision we make. He is
deeply committed to ensuring that every child and family we work with receives the same level of
compassionate, high-quality care that supported his own family.

Understanding the physical, emotional, and logistical challenges that families face is at the core
of our service. We work closely with families to provide the support, education, and resources
needed to navigate the complexities of caring for a child with medical needs. We believe that family
is at the heart of pediatric care. We actively involve families in the care process, and empower
them in their child’s care.

Our licensed nurses, and aides are more than just healthcare providers. They are caregivers who
understand the unique needs of pediatric patients and their families. Many of our team members have
a personal experience with pediatric medical conditions and caregiving, making them not only
qualified but deeply empathetic.

Our multidisciplinary team works together to create a comprehensive care plan for each child. We
coordinate with pediatricians, specialists, and other medical providers to ensure seamless,
well-rounded care is provided.

Navigating insurance and billing can be overwhelming. Our team is here to help you understand your
options, ensure eligibility, and manage the financial aspects of care, making the process as easy as
possible.

## Our Values

### Compassion

We treat every child and family with the highest level of kindness, empathy, and respect.

### Integrity

We operate with honesty, transparency, and accountability in all aspects of our care.

### Excellence

Following evidence based practice and providing continued education ensures that we provide the
highest standard of care in all of our services.

### Collaboration

We work closely with families and their healthcare team to ensure comprehensive, coordinated care is
provided.

## Ensuring Quality Pediatric Home Health Services Through Licensing and Accreditation

M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC is actively completing the required state licensing
process through the California Department of Public Health. This approval allows us to officially
provide licensed pediatric nursing, home health aide services, and care coordination in the home.
Once this step is finalized, we will move into the accreditation phase through a nationally
recognized accrediting body. Accreditation includes a detailed review of our safety procedures,

While we complete these important requirements, our team is preparing all systems, care protocols,

children and families across Northern California.

other body systems.

treat people with health problems resulting from injury or disease.

promoting health and wellness and are provided to those who have or are at risk for developing an
illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or
participation restriction.

interpersonal relationships, work and life adjustment, personal effectiveness, behavioral health,

registered at the clinical level in the jurisdiction of practice.

communication and swallowing across the life span from infancy through geriatrics.

# Bringing Pediatric Care and Hope Back Home

### A home pediatric nursing team that helps medically fragile clients and their families thrive. 

### A Home Pediatric Nursing Team Focused on Your Family’s Medical Ease

[Healthcare professionals interacting with a child in a medical or home care setting.]

Optimum Pediatric Services is a team of experienced home care nurses and clinicians focused on the
care and management of medically fragile children. 

 

Since 2016, we have worked closely with children navigating short and long-term medical conditions
and have supported parents in managing their caregiving duties, helping our clients and their
families to thrive. 

[A joyful mother and child outdoors, smiling and enjoying time together.]

#### Trusted by Georgia families for more than 10 years!

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

## EXPERIENCED NURSES

Your nurse works with you to help you better manage your health & achieve the best quality
lifestyle.

* Pain management
* Wound care and dressing changes

* Wound care

## TRUST & SAFETY. PEACE OF MIND GUARANTEE

If you want to be part of our team and you are a caring person with the knowledge to be a CNA, PCA,
RN, LPN or Companion/Sitter please apply here.
* **In - Person Interview**
  Every caregiver comes in for a face to face interview and personality assessment.
* CNA/RN Certification. Here at Integrity Home Care & Nursing Agency , we screen for specific
  nursing certifications such as CNA, PCA, RN , LPN , GNA and CMT.
* Background Check We run comprehensive federal , national , state and county- level background
  checks on all caregivers.
* Caregiver Matching Program We find the right caregiver for you by considering your specific needs
  , experience , personality , skill set , and much more. Our caregivers feel like family , and you
  and your loved ones will look forward to spending time together.
* Employer & Character References We contact multiple past employers to collect references and
  validate work history.
* RN is always on call Rest easy knowing that a Integrity Home Care & Nursing Agency RN is on call
  24/7 and ready to assist you should the need ever arise.
* No Contracts Pay only for the services provided, and you'll never have to worry about getting
  locked in to a contact .
* Bonded & Insured Integrity Home Care & Nursing Agency covers workman's compensation, unemployment
  benefits, training , state and employment taxes , as well as theft and up to # 3 million
  professional liability insurance for our care providers.
* OUR CORE VALUES:
  COMPASSION We are committed to understanding what others are going through , we empathize with
  them, and we show them that we love and care for them .
* INTEGRITY
  We commit ourselves to the quality of possessing and adhering to high moral principles and the
  highest of professional standards. We exist to do right by you and your loved one when no one is
  watching .
* EXCELLENCE
  We are committed to consistently delivering highest of quality services and fulfilling our
  client's needs promptly and thoroughly.
* REALIABILITY
  We are committed to consistently exercising all efforts possible to keep our word as promised .
* COLLABORATION
  We work in partnerships with all communities, hospice agencies, hospitals , VNAs and
  rehabilitation centers to make sure our clients are getting the best quality of care possible to
  thrive and be better than yesterday.
* DIGNITY
  We are fully committed to honor our clients with respect and privacy at all times.

## WHO WE ARE

## Reliable professionals putting heart into homecare, INTEGRITY ABOVE ALL.

Integrity Homecare And Nursing Service Agency is a family-owned business located in Peachtree
Corners, dedicated to providing exceptional care for children and seniors with disabilities. Founded
on the principles of integrity, compassion, and professionalism, Integrity Homecare And Nursing
Service Agency is committed to serving our community with the highest level of care and support.

[ Read More ][108]
[on call nursing agency]

## Services

As a family business, we understand the importance of building relationships based on trust and
respect. We treat every client like family, providing the same level of care and attention we would
want for our own loved ones. From assistance with daily activities ,skilled nursing to emotional
support and companionship, we are here to provide peace of mind and support for our clients and
their families. At Integrity Homecare And Nursing Service Agency, our mission is simple: to provide
therapeutic, and exceptional environment for both children and seniors with disabilities. We are
proud to serve our community and grateful for the opportunity to make a positive difference in the
lives of those we care for.

[nursing care]

### Assistance with all Activities of daily living

all.

### Transportation

To Doctors appointments, coordination of transport with Uber/Lyft and errands.

[icon]

### Medication Management

Daily medication reminders, administration and management.

[home nursing services atlanta]

### Laundry and Light Housekeeping

## EXPERIENCED NURSES

Your nurse works with you to help you better manage your health & achieve the best quality
lifestyle.

We have RNS and LPNs that can provide a high level of expertise & patient commitment. They are
trustworthy, loving, caring & will give you a peace of mind in the service they provide. We work to
recruit the most qualified & compassionate nurses. They are all screened, insured & licensed.
Nursing services provided include:
* Health & Home Assessments & Monitoring
* IV therapy (teach, support & encourage)
* Administration of injections (Diabetic & IVF)
* Pain management
* Wound care and dressing changes
* Chronic Disease management- medication administration
* Wound care
* Ostomy care
* Catheter care
* Tube feeding
* post surgery recovery

Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Client Reviews

[

In Oct 2021, when my mom was brought home, after Dr had given up on her life expectancy of not more
than 2 months. I was on the war path of making sure that the dr was wrong. Due to the whole medical
infrastructure getting collapsed for non covid patients they had very less time to take care of a a
Parkinson patient who became severely malnourished due to lack of eating. I was also sure that with
some TLC I could help her back to a healthy state. This needed a true and trusted partner. That's
what I found in Sunburst heath care headed by Dr Sujata. She was extremely empathetic and provided a
day time nurse who worked along side a full time house help and a regular physiotherapist to nurse
my mom back to a healthy state with in months. We had the service from Dr Sujata continuously for 17
months. Dr Sujata also helped us get regular Dr visits for both our aging parents. We would have
continued the service had it not been for the reasons that instead of a nurse my mom needed a
companion to speak to in her native (non-Marathi) language. I would definitely re-engage Sunburst,
if there is need in the future.

## Why Choose Us

### Thrive Skilled Pediatric Care provides high quality clinical home care to medically fragile
### children.

Everyone at **Thrive Skilled Pediatric Care** is committed to using the **brightest minds, the best
technology**, and the **biggest hearts to fulfill** our purpose: to provide high quality clinical
home care to medically fragile children so they can grow and flourish to their full potential. [Our
nurses][25] choose to work at Thrive SPC because they want to make a difference and be there for
your child’s worst days, their best days, and for all the many memorable moments and milestones in
between.

[Learn More][26]

Why Thrive SPC?

## Services

With more than 25 years of experience in pediatric home health care, the Thrive SPC team knows what
[resources][27] are available to support you and ensure your child receives the highest quality care
and the best foundation to reach their full potential.

# Pediatric Health Services

Nurse Founded and Operated Since 2009
[
[Nurse comforting small child]
Home Health Services
][55] [
[Nurse and parent interacting with small child]
Medical Day Centers
][56]
[Small child being held by mom with small red heart]

## Pediatric Care, Wherever You Need It

VIVA Pediatric Healthcare offers a compassionate and comprehensive approach to meeting the medical
needs of children from birth to the age of 20, from the comfort of their own home or in our
specialized Pediatric Medical Day Centers (PPECC).

Our services support families with children who have acute, chronic, or complex health conditions,
providing everything from skilled nursing and therapeutic interventions to daily care assistance.
For families seeking a nurturing, child-friendly environment, our Pediatric Medical Day Centers
offer expert medical care, social engagement, and developmental support tailored to meet each
child's unique needs.

[ Why VIVA? ][57]

## Specialized Care at Our Day Centers

Our Pediatric Medical Day Centers (PPECC) provide a specialized, safe, and supportive environment
for medically fragile children. We've designed our facilities to meet the unique needs of each
child. Our centers offer expert nursing care, therapies, and engaging activities that help children
thrive. 
* Individualized medical care and therapy services.
* Educational and social activities.
* Daily transportation to and from our centers.
* Customized Plan of Care.


With our compassionate approach, families gain peace of mind knowing their child is receiving
exceptional care in a nurturing space. [Schedule a visit][58].

[ What is a PPECC? ][59]
[Nurse holding baby in nursery]

## Help Finding the Right Pediatric Home Health Care Provider

From understanding the qualifications of our healthcare professionals to knowing how care plans are
tailored for each child, our FAQ's aim to provide clarity and confidence in your search.

We cover a wide range of topics, including service coverage, insurance and billing, safety
protocols, and how to initiate services, ensuring you have all the information you need at your
fingertips.

[ Questions & Answers ][60]

## Compassionate Care, Rewarding Careers

Embark on a rewarding career journey with us. We are committed to not only providing exceptional
care to our young patients and their families but also to ensuring the professional and personal
growth of our team members.

With us, you'll enjoy competitive salaries and a benefits package, including health, dental, and
retirement plans. Our supportive environment is designed to foster individual growth and team
collaboration, making it the perfect place to advance your career while making a significant impact
on the lives of the children we care for.

[ Visit Careers and Job Postings ][61]
[Nurse talking with small girl]

# Pediatric Health Services

Nurse Founded and Operated Since 2009
[
[Nurse comforting small child]
Home Health Services
][55] [
[Nurse and parent interacting with small child]
Medical Day Centers
][56]
[Small child being held by mom with small red heart]

## Pediatric Care, Wherever You Need It

VIVA Pediatric Healthcare offers a compassionate and comprehensive approach to meeting the medical
needs of children from birth to the age of 20, from the comfort of their own home or in our
specialized Pediatric Medical Day Centers (PPECC).

Our services support families with children who have acute, chronic, or complex health conditions,
providing everything from skilled nursing and therapeutic interventions to daily care assistance.
For families seeking a nurturing, child-friendly environment, our Pediatric Medical Day Centers
offer expert medical care, social engagement, and developmental support tailored to meet each
child's unique needs.

[ Why VIVA? ][57]

## Specialized Care at Our Day Centers

Our Pediatric Medical Day Centers (PPECC) provide a specialized, safe, and supportive environment
for medically fragile children. We've designed our facilities to meet the unique needs of each
child. Our centers offer expert nursing care, therapies, and engaging activities that help children
thrive. 
* Individualized medical care and therapy services.
* Educational and social activities.
* Daily transportation to and from our centers.
* Customized Plan of Care.


With our compassionate approach, families gain peace of mind knowing their child is receiving
exceptional care in a nurturing space. [Schedule a visit][58].

[ What is a PPECC? ][59]
[Nurse holding baby in nursery]

## Help Finding the Right Pediatric Home Health Care Provider

From understanding the qualifications of our healthcare professionals to knowing how care plans are
tailored for each child, our FAQ's aim to provide clarity and confidence in your search.

We cover a wide range of topics, including service coverage, insurance and billing, safety
protocols, and how to initiate services, ensuring you have all the information you need at your
fingertips.

[ Questions & Answers ][60]

## Compassionate Care, Rewarding Careers

Embark on a rewarding career journey with us. We are committed to not only providing exceptional
care to our young patients and their families but also to ensuring the professional and personal
growth of our team members.

With us, you'll enjoy competitive salaries and a benefits package, including health, dental, and
retirement plans. Our supportive environment is designed to foster individual growth and team
collaboration, making it the perfect place to advance your career while making a significant impact
on the lives of the children we care for.

[ Visit Careers and Job Postings ][61]

[ Our services ][41]

GMP CDMO focused on different stages of the process.

We work exclusively in lentivirus, offering comprehensive services.

### Customized service

Technical adaptation and timely slot availability for each project.

### Quality and regulatory

Compliance with EMA and FDA regulatory requirements.

kitchen of J.H. Whitney’s original Rockefeller Center, New York offices.



With his personal investment of $5 million in 1946 to capitalize J.H. Whitney, Jock Whitney set the
stage for a significant change in American capitalism. Our firm honors Jock’s legacy today by
continuing his vision of providing capital and assistance to companies with the potential to achieve
sustained superior performance.

fund private equity activities in the ensuing years. Over the succeeding several decades, new and

its seventh outside private equity fund and continues to attract its capital from leading
foundations, universities, pension funds and other institutions.

J.H. Whitney introduced the world to Minute Maid Orange Juice, a product in part developed in the
kitchen of J.H. Whitney’s original Rockefeller Center, New York offices.
